title: Reviewer Methodology Review Questions
description: Questions that guide reviewer methodology reasoning.

entries.title: What is the first observation?
entries.description: Start with a neutral observation before any finding.

entries.title: What is the primary evidence?
entries.description: Name the strongest evidence, not every clue.

entries.title: What context changes the reading?
entries.description: Track nearby sentences and cross-scene context.

entries.title: Does another sentence change the meaning?
entries.description: Never stop at one sentence when more context exists.

entries.title: Does another scene change the meaning?
What is the reviewer intent?
entries.description: Separate review comment, possible finding, and confirmed finding.

entries.title: How confident is the reading?
entries.description: Calibrate confidence to the quality of the evidence.

entries.title: Does an exception apply?
entries.description: Check quotation, fiction, history, education, and other exceptions.

entries.title: Could this be a false positive?
Could something be missed?
entries.description: Look for undercalled evidence or hidden context.
